profile.headline: Software Engineering Leader | Managing High-Performing Teams | Driving Innovation at MITRE
profile.summary:
I am a software engineering leader with over 30 years of experience delivering transformative technology solutions across government, industry, and academia. Throughout my career, I've had the privilege of leading cross-functional teams of software engineers, UX designers, and analysts to deliver mission-critical systems that make a difference.

At MITRE, I guide technical strategy for 85+ engineers and lead projects for federal agencies such as the FCC. My work has included building accessibility solutions for the d/Deaf and Hard of Hearing community, developing national health platforms like Connect2Health, and supporting U.S. courts with critical system evaluations. Along the way, I've been honored with multiple MITRE awards recognizing innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence.

In addition to my industry work, I've been a professor of computer science and software engineering for over a decade, helping shape the next generation of engineers. Mentoring and developing people is one of my greatest passions.

I am now looking to bring my leadership experience into a role managing a team of software developers — where I can combine my technical expertise, team-building skills, and passion for mentoring to deliver impactful results.

positions.title: Department Chief Engineer / Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Provide technical leadership to 85+ engineers across multiple government-sponsored projects.
• Drive strategic hiring decisions, staff mentoring, and professional development initiatives.
• Partner with federal agencies to architect secure, scalable, mission-driven systems.

positions.title: Project Leader / Task Leader
positions.description:
• Lead a 10-person team on FCC Telecommunications Relay Services, improving accessibility for the d/Deaf and Hard of Hearing community.
• Directed The Fight Is In Us COVID-19 project, creating 25 websites to recruit plasma donors.
• Directed 14 engineers, UX designers, and analysts on FCC Connect2Health Mapping Broadband Health in America.
• Earned MITRE Trailblazer Award (2024), three Synergist Awards (2024), MITRE Breakthrough Award (2021), Catalyst Award (2021), and Program Recognition Award (2020).

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Conducted independent technical assessment of U.S. Federal Judiciary case management systems.
• Awarded MITRE Program Recognition Award (2018).

positions.locationName: West Long Branch, New Jersey · On-site
positions.description:
• Teach graduate-level courses in software engineering.
• Serve on the CS/SE Advisory Board to align curriculum with industry needs.

positions.description:
